findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "check_citation" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "check_citation" is 8183 chars, far longer than this server's median (1085). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_cases, find_case, get_case, check_citation, get_treatment, check_brief, find_issues · Private data: search_cases, find_case, check_citation, check_brief, find_court, find_authority, suggest_treatment, export_document, brief_upload, get_brief_results · Public sink: search_cases, find_case, check_citation, check_brief, brief_upload · Destructive: search_cases, find_case, get_case, verify_quote, check_brief, get_propositions, search_quotes, find_authority, export_document, brief_delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_cases, find_case, get_case, check_citation, get_treatment, check_brief, find_issues · Private data: search_cases, find_case, check_citation, check_brief, find_court, find_authority, suggest_treatment, export_document, brief_upload, get_brief_results · Public sink: search_cases, find_case, check_citation, check_brief, brief_upload · Destructive: search_cases, find_case, get_case, verify_quote, check_brief, get_propositions, search_quotes, find_authority, export_document, brief_delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
